title: fix(packages): Setup list + creator agree with the builder on writability
body:
Second PR from the UX review: Setup › Packages and the application builder disagreed about the same package's nature.

- **Display**: `ScopeBadge` defaulted a missing scope to `project` — writable DB bases wore the identical badge as read-only code packages. Now: scope-less → **可写/Writable** (emerald), `project` → **只读 · 代码包 / Read-only · code** — same language as the builder's switcher/landing.
- **Semantics (real bug)**: the New Package dialog hardcoded `scope: 'project'` onto runtime-created bases, so packages created in Setup were mislabeled **read-only** by the builder. New bases are now created scope-less, identical to the builder's own creator.

**Browser-verified**: showcase → Read-only·code, builder-created 库存中心 → Writable; a package created through Setup's dialog (com.example.warehouse) lands **scope-less** (writable). `type-check`: 0 errors.
